microsoft365.name: Microsoft 365 public status
microsoft365.client_impact: This source can confirm broad public Microsoft 365 incidents and the scope Microsoft publishes. It does not certify tenant or workload health for Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune, Microsoft 365 Apps, Defender, Power Platform, or other subscribed services.
microsoft365.technician_action: Use the public incident feed only for the incident scope Microsoft actually publishes. Check tenant Microsoft 365 Service Health or Microsoft Graph service communications before concluding that a workload is healthy or affected.

kaseya.client_impact: May affect Autotask PSA, Datto, Kaseya RMM, backup, or MSP operations.
kaseya.technician_action: Confirm the affected US product and region on the Kaseya status page before changing local systems.

datto.name: NUSO
datto.client_impact: May affect UCaaS, inbound/outbound calling, Teams or Zoom bridges, Operator Connect, SMS/MMS, emergency calling, CPaaS, portals, or APIs.
datto.technician_action: Check NUSO incident/component scope and upstream carrier status before changing PBX, SIP, routing, or client voice configuration.
